CustomField.description: If populated, this is the timestamp that a Reg B notice or a Notice of Incomplete Application was sent for this Consumer Risk Summary. If blank, this Consumer Risk Summary has not received a notice of either type. Corresponds with the Decline Email Template field value.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When the Reg B Notice or Notice of Incomplete Application was sent.
CustomField.label: Decline Email Sent Date/Time
